column3: “Present yourself” is rendered “show yourself,” and “give rain” as “send rain.”
NASB opens a parenthesis that continues through verse 4.
“Cut off” is rendered “destroyed,” and “food” as “bread.” NASB closes the parenthesis.
“To pass through it” is rendered “to survey it.”
“What have I sinned” is rendered “What sin have I committed.”
The oath form “if there is a nation” is rendered “there is no nation”; NASB supplies “He is not here.”
“Of the Asherah” is kept; NASB supplies “together with.”
“Limping on two crutches” is rendered “hesitate between two opinions”; the meaning of the image is uncertain.
“Young bulls” is rendered “oxen,” and NASB supplies “under it.”
“The word is good” is rendered “That is a good idea.”
“Limped around” is rendered “leaped about.” The Hebrew reads “which he made”; NASB has “they made.”
“Musing” is rendered “occupied,” and “a going away” as “gone aside” (possibly a euphemism).
“Prophesied” is rendered “raved,” and NASB supplies “of the evening sacrifice.”
